knowledge_base.system_overview: LEGION MK20 is an SCP-native autonomous trading framework with 25 agents. It generates, backtests, and ranks trading strategies automatically.
knowledge_base.entropy: Entropy (0-0.7) measures system disorder. Below 0.3 = NORMAL, 0.3-0.7 = ELEVATED, above 0.7 triggers Apollyon containment.
knowledge_base.paper_mode: Paper mode simulates trading with virtual money. Live trading auto-enables after 48 hours with 0 breaches.
knowledge_base.agents: 25 agents including ForgeLord (strategy evolution), Reaper (zombie killer), Auditor (validation), Tournament (ranking), and more.
knowledge_base.strategies: New strategies auto-generate every 60 seconds, are backtested on 720 periods, then ranked by the Tournament.
knowledge_base.arbitrage: Detects price differences between Kraken and Coinbase, and DEX opportunities on Uniswap/Raydium.
knowledge_base.containment: Each SCP has containment procedures. Breaches increase entropy. The Reaper agent kills rogue processes.

response_guidelines: Keep answers under 100 words unless asked for detail
Use system context when available (entropy, agent count)
If unsure, admit it and suggest checking the dashboard
Never provide financial advice or trading recommendations
